resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 485 ft (148 m). OpenStreetMap's ele tag gives 146 m. The record uses the register's figure, which is the one the brief already carried.

sources.title: The Aermotor Company: From Windmills to Forest Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: The only detailed source is the 2022 NHLR entry, so the story has almost no build or fire history. Two searches and four page reads found no build date, staffing or fire record. Access is 'restricted' by inference from the register's active-use line; no source states a public access rule. The 100 ft height is converted to 30.5 m. The Forest Lookouts index confirms the name and county only. Brief record matched on agency, elevation and registration date; no corrections proposed.
